short: Gabriel Soca offers Akashic Records readings, Tarot, Reiki, Energy Cleansing and Rune readings online for people around the world. Readings are delivered in writing, and distance Reiki and Energy Cleansing include a written report.
training: Training in Reiki and a background in communication. I have offered remote readings and energy sessions since June 2023.
pricing: Private payment. Prices vary by service and are listed on my website; please contact me through WhatsApp to confirm the service and current price before paying. Bank transfer and PayPal are available.
long:
I am Gabriel Soca. I offer Akashic Records readings, Tarot, Reiki, Energy Cleansing and Rune readings entirely online, for people in different countries.

Akashic Records, Tarot and Rune readings begin with your questions and are delivered in writing, so you can return to them whenever you need. Tarot and Runes focus on understanding the present and exploring possibilities rather than predicting a fixed future.

Reiki and Energy Cleansing are provided remotely and include a written report. My approach is attentive and respectful of each person’s situation. Written readings do not require an appointment. You can find the details of all five services on my website and contact me through WhatsApp.
size: An independent practice run by one practitioner, serving clients online worldwide.
